answer.text: Declaration of 'fit and proper' status and committed capital of 5% of corpus or Rs. 10 crore (whichever lower)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 5.2.3 Declaration, Sponsor/Manager must declare fit-and-proper status and commit capital of 5% or Rs. 10 crore (whichever lower). **The Trap:** Narrow declarations miss required disclosures. **Cross-Exam Context:** Tested across Topic 2 and Topic 4. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Sponsor declaration should be notarised and in the SEBI-prescribed format.
